headline: Joby Aviation completes fully autonomous flight across the US, covering 3,199 miles
summary: Joby Aviation's converted Cessna Caravan flew 3,199 miles from California to North Carolina without human input, marking a significant step for autonomous aviation beyond urban air taxis.
details: Joby Aviation has achieved the "first-ever autonomous flight across the United States." An aircraft outfitted with its autonomous flight system completed a 3,199-mile journey from California to North Carolina without human input.

The company integrated its autonomy technology into a converted Cessna Caravan. This aircraft performed all flight phases, including taxiing, takeoff, cruising, and landing, without any control inputs from an onboard safety pilot.

While a human monitor was on the aircraft, Joby remotely supervised the flight from its headquarters in California and Shaw Air Force Base in South Carolina. The aircraft will now travel westward, making stops in cities like Raleigh, Salt Lake City, and Portland.

This achievement expands Joby's capabilities beyond its well-known piloted electric air taxis, which began demoing in New York City in April. The company plans to launch these air taxis to the public later this year.

Joby suggests its autonomous flight system can be integrated into existing aircraft for various applications. These include commercial freight, emergency response, and defense logistics, opening new avenues for the startup.

headline_marked: [[OpenAI's ad collector]] links ChatGPT activity to your web browsing
headline: OpenAI's ad collector links ChatGPT activity to your web browsing
summary: A new tracking cookie allows OpenAI to connect what you do on other websites to your ChatGPT account, potentially impacting its answers.
details: OpenAI has implemented an ad collector at bzr.openai.com that sets a cookie, __obi, scoped to .openai.com. This cookie is sent to OpenAI from ordinary websites visited by users while logged into ChatGPT.

Companies buying ads on ChatGPT can install a small piece of OpenAI code on their sites. Loading this code sends __obi to OpenAI, along with data about the pages browsed, including products searched for, articles read, and purchase behaviors.

This mechanism allows OpenAI to connect a user's activity on external websites directly to their ChatGPT account. Researchers have reproduced and verified this full mechanism, analyzing traffic across numerous advertiser pixels and hostnames.

The __obi cookie is configured with SameSite=None and Secure, enabling it to be sent on cross-site requests. This is the only OpenAI identifier with this configuration, differentiating it from other OpenAI cookies that are blocked by browsers.

The tracking extends to scraping data from advertiser pages, including form fields, rendered text, and tag-manager data. While some identity data is deliberately passed by advertisers, the SDK scrapes significantly more.

Email and phone numbers are collected and SHA-256 hashed before transmission. Location data like country, region, city, and postal code are sent in clear text. OpenAI's Ads Manager controls automatic matching, with a denylist excluding sensitive fields like passwords and SSNs.

This tracking was observed on multiple commercial websites, including Chewy, Wayfair, and Coursera. The __obi value was sent to OpenAI from these sites, indicating a broad reach for this data collection.
